section.title: AI Video Background Changer & Design Agent
section.description: Ditch the green screens and expensive studio rentals. Lovart's AI Design Agent is the ultimate video background changer, allowing you to instantly replace messy surroundings with hyper-realistic, AI-generated environments. Powered by the MCoT engine, effortlessly extract subjects, prompt Nano Banana Pro for custom 4K scenes, and achieve flawless lighting harmonization on an infinite ChatCanvas.

items.question: How is Lovart different from regular video background changers?
items.answer: Traditional tools only give you a transparent video or force you to use generic stock backgrounds. Lovart is an AI Design Agent operating on an infinite ChatCanvas. You remove the background and immediately prompt the AI to generate a brand-new, hyper-realistic environment, compositing the final video in one seamless workflow.

items.question: Do I need a green screen to use the video background changer?
items.answer: No green screen is needed! Lovart's advanced AI models analyze depth and motion to intelligently separate your main subject from complex, cluttered, or moving backgrounds with incredible frame-by-frame accuracy.

items.question: Can I make the subject match the lighting of the new background?
items.answer: Yes. One of Lovart's most powerful features is 'Touch Edit'. Once you change the video background, you can use conversational commands to adjust the lighting, shadows, and color grading of your subject so it naturally blends into the new AI-generated environment.

items.question: What file formats and resolutions does Lovart support?
items.answer: You can upload standard video formats like MP4 and MOV. After swapping the scene, you can export the high-quality composited video. Our built-in Upscale feature can enhance your final output up to crisp 4K resolution.

items.question: Can I use the videos with changed backgrounds for commercial ads?
items.answer: Yes. Users subscribed to any of our paid plans (Starter, Plus, Pro) retain full commercial rights to the assets they generate and edit on Lovart. You can safely use your new videos for paid ads, client deliverables, and social media monetization.
